title: Fairy of the Heart Portal
description: A red-skinned fairy with large glowing wings stands barefoot on stone steps at the edge of a turbulent sea, releasing pink hearts from her outstretched hand. Behind her, a stone doorway reveals a distant tower in a glowing portal while a clock and heart-shaped locket float in a beam of light from a dramatic, stormy sky filled with purple clouds.
prompt: A beautiful red-skinned fairy with long braided hair and large iridescent wings stands on rocky steps by the ocean at dusk, releasing glowing pink hearts from her hand. A magical stone doorway beside her reveals a lit tower across the water. In the stormy purple sky, a floating clock and ornate heart locket emit beams of golden light. Bioluminescent heart-shaped plants grow in the foreground, dramatic clouds, fantasy style.
